notes.content: I found a few bugs in the game that I squashed right away.

notes.title: Improved The Way The Monsters Attack
notes.content: If you are one of the many people who struggled with beating nights 6 and 7 of Childhood Fears, then this is the update for you! To keep it simple, I have added a system that only allows a certain number of monsters to attack at once. This is a dramatic improvement from before when you could have up to 8 monsters attacking at once (the max amount is now 4)! This will make the game possible to beat while still keeping a high level of difficulty. I hope you all enjoy this giant patch. Let me know if there are any issues and I will be sure to fix them! Have a nice day!

notes.title: Fixed a minor bug that messed with steam
notes.content: Fixed a minor bug that caused the game to not open in steam.

notes.title: Added Language Support
notes.content:
I have officially added five additional languages to the game! Unfoutunelty, I could not include two of the languages I had previously said I would do to translation issues, however, I did include one extra one.

The Languages add are Spanish, Russian, French, German, and Portuguese.

I hope this update will make it easier for people of other cultures to play the game!

Other additions:

[list]
[*] Added an instructions button to the pause menu. This will allow you to look over what you are supposed to do to scare away the monsters.
[*] 
[*] Added subtitles. This will make it easier to understand what is being said during the phone calls.
[*] 
[*] Fixed saving bug. There was a bug that would cause the game to not save if it was closed using the X button at the top of the window. It will no longer do that.
[*] 
[*] Minor tweaks to monster aggressiveness.
[*] 
[*] Mike's phone calls can now be skipped immediately. Some people were annoyed that they had to listen to the beginning of Mikes's phone calls every time they had to restart a level. (I understand! I had to listen to them for HOURS trying to get them to work right.) You now skip it right away.
[/list]

notes.title: New Language Support Coming Soon!
notes.content:
I will be adding new languages to Childhood Fears for all the people around the world who want to play this game! I have seen a lot of people try playing this and it was clear how difficult it was since they could not understand it. I have a list of the languages being added right here, and if anyone has a language they want me to add let me know! I should note that the languages are only being add in subtitles. Unfortunately, I do know how to speak any other language and do not have the funds to pay other voice actors to do it, otherwise, I would do that. I think this will be fine though, as I will also add an instructions option so people will be able to reread anything they might have missed in the phone calls.

Languages being added:

Española (Spanish)
Pусский (Russian)
عربى (Arabic)
Deutsche (German)
Français (French)
日本語 (Japanese)

Again, if let me know if there is a language you want me to add!

notes.title: Lowered diffaculty of nights 6 & 7.
notes.content: I noticed a lot of people were having too much trouble beating the last two levels. While I wanted it to be hard, I don't want it to be too hard. To fix this I made the monsters a little less aggressive for the end of the game. Hopefully, people have an easier time playing it now.

notes.title: Is Childhood Fears Too Hard?
notes.content: So I have noticed that a lot of people have been having trouble with night 6 and 7 of Childhood Fears. I just want to know, has anyone has beaten the game yet? If not, then I think I will lower the difficulty of night 6 and 7. After all, what's the point of getting a game if you can't finish. Let me know if there is anything else I should do to improve the game. I want to make it as fun as possible.
